page_title: WHU 2-0 MNU | West Ham v Manchester Utd 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The whistle blows and Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is booked for an infringement.
90+6' The ball possession is 34:66.
90+4' David Moyes has decided to make a change. Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) replaces Mohammed Kudus.
90+1' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Jarrod Bowen did his best and is replaced by Pablo Fornals (West Ham).
86' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
85' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Erik ten Hag decides to make a substitution. Alejandro Garnacho will be replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
84' Willy Kambwala comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sergio Reguilon (Manchester United).
81' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:3.

78' 2 - 0 Lucas Paqueta passes to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 2:0.
77' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Andre Onana easily deals with the threat.
74' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) coming on for Antony.
72' 1 - 0 Goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.

72' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Andre Onana leaps like a salmon to deny him.
69' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared.
68' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
66' Manchester Utd enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
64' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
62' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
60' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
59' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester Utd.
57' The substitution is prepared. Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rasmus Hojlund.
57' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

56' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. West Ham will take a corner kick.
56' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
55' Emerson (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Now West Ham have a corner.
53' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
52' Simon Hooper interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United).
51' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.

49' A bullet header by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
48' Manchester Utd control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Referee Simon Hooper blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+3' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
45+2' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Antony (Manchester United) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
43' The yellow card goes to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
43' Shots on target – 1:3.
40' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take a corner kick.

40' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Alphonse Areola stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner. Manchester Utd earn a corner.
39' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

39' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
37' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

35' He should have scored! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Alphonse Areola makes an easy save.
32' Half-chance! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) plays a pass into the box, but Alphonse Areola reacts well to snuff out the attack.
29' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
28' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
27' The percentage of ball possession is – 39:61.
25' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
21' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him.

17' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 45:55.
13' The resulting corner, taken by Luke Shaw (Manchester United), comes to nothing.
12' A cross into the box from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is cleared.
11' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Alphonse Areola comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

5' Emerson (West Ham) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
2' The West Ham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Simon Hooper will officiate today.
